plugins.name: agentwhy
plugins.description: On agentwhy's page you choose which private files to block from your AI and which to track. From then on it checks every conversation by itself, and tells you in the chat when your AI was stopped from opening one or read one. Its report shows what your AI did in each conversation: the files it read, the ones it only saw by name, and where it went. Its hooks run agentwhy on this computer before and after your AI acts; nothing is uploaded.
